# netbox_cooling_feed (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/coolingfeed/):

> A cooling feed represents the supply of cooling from a cooling source to a rack or another piece of equipment.

Requires NetBox v4.7.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_cooling_feed" "example" {
  name              = "example"
  cooling_source_id = netbox_cooling_source.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cooling_source_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `cooling_capacity` (Number) Rated cooling capacity (kW).
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `max_flow` (Number)
- `max_flow_unit` (String) One of [lpm, m3ph, gpm].
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `rack_id` (Number)
- `status` (String) One of [offline, active, planned, failed].
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
